control_results.summary: The approved environment reference and opaque subject references were bound to the run.
The supplied before snapshot represented the admitted subject access as present across the named paths.
The supplied after snapshot represented the admitted subject access as absent across the named paths.
The four access paths were explicitly named without raw identities, keys, or credentials.
The decision owner recorded the access-removal result as complete for the admitted scope.
